modes.cue_notes: Sit simply in an easy cross-legged seat, hands resting on the knees, spine tall but unforced, eyes closed. Used as a settle-in or close point rather than an active shape — no cueing beyond arriving and breathing.

breathing_cues.entering: Settle into the seat and let the breath find its own natural rhythm.
breathing_cues.holding: Simply observe the breath moving in and out, without changing it.
breathing_cues.exiting: Take one deeper breath, then softly open the eyes.
